_comment: Portfolio on index.html. Order here = order on the site. Run: python3 tools/games/update_games.py

games.description: Dive from your boat into reefs, shipwrecks and sunken ruins, grab pearls and pirate gold and get back up before the air runs out. Better gear takes you deeper.
A cosy side-view ant colony simulator: draw tunnels with your finger and watch your colony dig, gather food, defend the nest and grow.
Smash through the zombie horde in an armoured jeep, jump out with your squad to clear the streets, rescue survivors, defend the base and take the city back.
A relaxing track-building puzzle in cosy steampunk style: lay straight rails, curves and switches before the steam train gets there.
A sweet match-3 puzzle with a cheerful little bee: swap candies, build juicy combos and blast through 100+ levels in a blooming meadow.
Turn a street busker into the biggest band in the world: gather a crowd, hire musicians and grow a music empire that earns even offline.
A cozy coloring book with cute unicorns, kittens, puppies and dozens of other kawaii pictures. Finish a picture and save it to your gallery.
A colourful, relaxing bubble shooter with a cheerful fox: aim, bounce shots off the walls and pop groups of three or more bubbles.
Build your own pocket tower hotel from toy bricks, hire workers and superheroes and grow it into a hotel empire.
Your motorcycle rides by itself, your job is to stay alive: jump ramps, drift and take out gangsters in slow-motion shootouts.
A one-button bike racer: hold to open the throttle, let go before you crash and be the first to cross the line.
Lead a special forces squad against the undead: top-down shooting, base defence and RPG upgrades to win the city back block by block.
Take over a struggling maternity hospital and make it the most profitable in the city: open wards, upgrade equipment and hire staff.
A calm connect-the-pipes puzzle: turn the pipes until the route on a broken space station runs from source to goal. No timer, no move limits.

games.name: Aircraft Constructor Idler
games.description: An idle factory game: deliver parts, assemble aircraft and expand your own plane production line.
Command a tank and make precise long-range shots through a sniper scope with cannon, machine gun and air strikes.
Rescue wild animals on farmland: track them with a thermal scope, put them to sleep with tranquilizer darts and release them safely.
Play as an escaped alien spider: stretch your tentacles through mazes, avoid traps and drag scientists to your jaws.
Tap to switch the magnet on and guide the character through tricky mazes, avoiding obstacles on the way to the exit.
